Judgement: both supplied archives are BENIGN; detector false positives.

Compared paired 0.16.1 with the preceding crates.io release 0.16.0:
https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/paired/0.16.0/download
Only Cargo.toml, Cargo.toml.orig and .cargo_vcs_info.json differ.
The manifest pins ff to =0.5.0 and updates groupy from 0.2.0 to 0.2.1.
All source and test vector files are byte-identical.
g1_hashtopoint.dat and g1_uncompressed_valid_test_vectors.dat each hold
1000 96-byte points; every non-infinity point satisfies y^2 = x^3 + 4
over the BLS12-381 base field. g2_compressed_valid_test_vectors.dat holds
1000 96-byte compressed Fq2 point records. The test harness compares these
bytes against hashing and point serialization results; it never executes them.
The benchmark hex arrays are deterministic XorShiftRng seeds.

Compared caniuse-lite 1.0.30000913 with 1.0.30000912:
https://registry.npmjs.org/caniuse-lite/-/caniuse-lite-1.0.30000912.tgz
Only four feature tables, README formatting, CHANGELOG and version differ.
The changed tables are abortcontroller, imports, web-app-manifest and webgl2.
All region tables and unpacker code are byte-identical.
The regional underscore strings list browser versions with missing usage;
dist/unpacker/region.js splits them on spaces and assigns null to each version.
The older recognizer assumed C then D browser ordering. These tables start D.
Require all table fragments and a whole-file data-only export before exclusion.

Thus the supplied historical clean result cannot be explained by a change to
any flagged member: the same bytes would meet the original current matchers.
Retain neutral entropy/hex representation facts, remove entropy-only intent,
and recognize the regional data schema without suppressing appended code.

Controls: python3 testdata/triage/version-drift/check.py
The runner copies fixtures outside testdata so test-directory exclusions
cannot conceal numeric-list detection or an erroneous data-only exclusion.
